forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Warrior is one of the four default classes of the new Skyborne race.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Victory Rush is baseline in Arms: instant, 30 second cooldown, heals 10% of maximum health within 20 seconds of a non-trivial kill. Tactical Mastery is a passive rather than a talent.

Shield Wall is a 15 minute cooldown reducing damage 60% for 12 seconds, where Classic was 30 minutes, 75% and 10 seconds; Shield Block has 2 charges and lasts 7 seconds; Thunder Clap works in Battle or Defensive Stance and rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 seconds against up to 4 targets.
New talents include Spearing Strike and Bloodthrill in Arms, Raging Blows in Fury and Vanguard in Protection; Death Wish's penalty is now 5% more damage taken instead of reduced armour.

Undead is a new Paladin race in Forever, shown in an announcement cinematic.

forever_changes.text: One press roundup reports a Seal usable for tanking, deeper group healing and a fuller Retribution tree; Blizzard has not confirmed these directly.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Undead can now be Paladins.
Holy Strike returns as a baseline attack at level 6, Judgement no longer consumes Seals, Seal of Fury tanks with a 10-yard taunt on Judgement, and Consecration is baseline at 20.

Holy Strike is on a 12 second cooldown and had reached rank 5 by level 38 in the demo; Seal of Fury's absorb is worth about half the Holy damage it adds, and Judging it taunts for 4 seconds at 10 yards where every other taunt is 5.

Holy gains Improved Holy Strike, Voice of Truth, Reverence, Infusion of Light and Light's Vigil; Protection gains Improved Seal of Fury, Shield Specialization, Swift Judgement, Templar's Bulwark and Iron Creed; Retribution gains Vindication, Sacred Arbiter, Champion of the Light, Instrument of Law and Twist of Light.
Blessing of Kings and Consecration are trainable rather than talents; Illumination now refunds roughly 50% of the mana on a critical heal and Redoubt triggers on any damaging melee hit.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Hunter is one of the four default classes of the new Skyborne race.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Humans can now be Hunters.

Aimed Shot is trainable rather than a Marksmanship talent, with a 2 second cast on a 6 second cooldown shared with Multi-Shot, where Classic was a 3 second cast; Aspect of the Beast now also grants 50 melee attack power at rank 1.
New talents include Lone Wolf, which grants 20% more damage with no active pet, Summon Hawk, and Resourcefulness; Trueshot Aura moved up the tree and grants ranged attack power only.

Rogue is one of the four default classes of the new Skyborne race.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Rogues can use one-handed axes; the Hack and Slash talent treats Axe and Sword as one weapon group.

New talents include Mutilate and Venom in Assassination, Restless Blades in Combat and Cutthroat in Subtlety; Weapon Expertise now reduces enemy dodge and parry chance instead of granting weapon skill.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Gnomes can now be Priests.
Fear Ward is baseline for every Priest on a 3 minute cooldown, and Devouring Plague is a normal Shadow spell rather than an Undead racial.

Priest racial spells are reworked per race: Human gains Divine Grace, Gnome gains Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan, Night Elf's Elune's Grace now reduces melee and ranged hit chance by 50%, and Troll's Hex of Weakness cuts attack power instead of flat melee damage.
New talents include Penance and Divine Aegis in Discipline and Litany of Light and Prayer of Mending in Holy; Meditation gives 17% mana regeneration while casting at rank 1 against Classic's 5%.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Dwarf Shaman was shown in a hands-on demo at BlizzCon 2026, per one outlet.
Skyborne can be Shaman only when they choose the Horde at character creation.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Dwarves can now be Shamans.

Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cast half a second faster than Classic before any talent, and Ghost Wolf's base cast is 2 seconds with Improved Ghost Wolf making it instant and usable indoors at 2 of 2.

Fire Nova is a spell rather than a totem, detonating within 10 yards of your active Fire totem on a 10 second cooldown; Totemic Projection moves your totems to a spot up to 30 yards away, and Call of the Elements drops up to four totems in one 3 second cast.

New talents include Lava Burst in Elemental, Maelstrom Weapon and Spirit Weapons in Enhancement and Water Shield in Restoration; Stormstrike now increases the Nature damage you deal rather than amplifying the next two Nature sources on the target.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Skyborne can be Mages only when they choose the Alliance at character creation.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Orcs can now be Mages.
Two new abilities appear in the demo: Frostfire Bolt, which counts as both Fire and Frost and is named by four talents, and Comprehend Scroll, seen on a Skyborne Mage.

Mage has the fewest new talents and the most changed of any class in one tally of the demo trees; Arcane Blast and Hot Streak are new and Improved Counterspell's silence is guaranteed but short at rank 1.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.
Trolls can now be Warlocks.

Banes and Curses are separate categories, so one of each can run on a target: Curse of Agony is Bane of Agony and Curse of Doom is Bane of Doom. Enslave Demon is renamed Subjugate Demon, and a new Incubus summon is named by four Demonology talents.
New talents include Pandemic, Drain Hope and Malevolence, which lets damage-over-time effects critically strike; Warlock has the largest tree rework of any class in one tally of the demo trees.

forever_changes.text: Every class gets a revamped talent tree built around meaningful trade-offs.
Druid is one of the four default classes of the new Skyborne race, whose forms are sky-blue.
Talent trees keep their rows, with one-point milestones at 11, 21, and 31 points plus a new 16-point milestone; key buff talents are baseline.

Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp are trainable rather than talents; Revive is a new 10 second out-of-combat resurrection, Lacerate is in as a baseline Bear bleed learned after level 30, and Cure Poison is gone.
New talents include Genesis in Balance, Nature's Majesty and Berserk in Feral; Feral Charge gains a separate Cat version and Primal Fury also grants combo points on Cat critical strikes.
